title: Professional SOP and Quality Systems Specialist Practical
criticalErrors: Approves or recommends an undocumented process change that bypasses required change control for a controlled procedure.
Closes a deviation or CAPA without preserving the original evidence or defining effectiveness verification.
Uses training attendance alone as proof of task competence when performance qualification is required by the supplied case.
Falsifies, deletes, or obscures audit, deviation, training, or change-control evidence.
